title: SynthWorlds-SM R1 Retrainfix v4
description: Private exploratory follow-up preserving the v3 evaluation split and adding 85 source-verified Type-B three-edge train-only chains. Derived from kenqgu/SynthWorlds (CC-BY-4.0); NLLB translations are CC-BY-NC-4.0. AI-only automated consistency checks; no fluent human review. Research pilot; not human-validated multilingual data. New private dataset slug for the retain-sampler-corrected rerun; preserves prior v3/v4 datasets.
